project.name: nablatensor-cva
project.description: CVA risk capital (Phase 2): a Monte-Carlo netting-set exposure engine on the adjoint tape, unilateral CVA whose full risk vector — IR, counterparty CS01, recovery — comes off one reverse sweep, plus BA-CVA (reduced and full with CDS hedges), SA-CVA (sensitivities-based charge on the shared NestedAggregation), a collateral model (VM threshold / MTA / MPoR), and the three PRA standardised methods.
